policy.discounted_variants: One-energy variants explicitly require selection in the Seasonal Artifact; retain evidence, do not silently substitute them for ordinary options. Unlock/Artifact eligibility is not implemented.
policy.capacity_boundary: Capacity belongs to each item definition or explicit integral count roll. The reference chest does not define a global D2 cap; tier-specific or legacy capacities and upgrade systems require their own catalogue.
policy.scope: Allocation at equipment validation, independent of current Super, ADS, weapon match or active effect. This is not Armor Charge and is never consumed by combat.
